answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to forge a public work record before it earns trust. Completed jobs, signed receipts, and peer attestations pile up over time, so a fresh identity starts with nothing. A juniper grows slow roots the same way, and a raven that turns up with no history of carrying messages gets ignored. New accounts can still join, but they cannot fake months of verifiable work overnight, which makes spinning up a thousand sock puppets expensive and obvious.
